name: zc_shadows

tests.name: no two lights are fighting over the same shadow

detail.note: the fills light the scene without casting, so only the sun draws a shadow

tests.name: the sun's shadow bias is in the working band, and it has cascades to spend

detail.note: below the band is acne on lit surfaces; above it, a shadow that floats off its object

tests.name: with the sky and the camera held still, the shadows hold still too

detail.note: mean luminance change per sample across 0.8 s; the control is the same scene with r.ShadowQuality 0, so TSR's own jitter is subtracted rather than assumed away

tests.name: the measurement actually looked at something

detail.note: flat on both sides means the render target came back empty, not that the world was still; that is a failure of this job rather than a pass for the product
